name: upstream-failure-empty
description: The shape that makes the envelope alone an unsafe billing signal, recorded live 2026-09-23: Bright Data answers HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body and `x-brd-status-code: 502` — it accepted the request, could not complete the unlock, and delivered nothing. The engine's sniffing decode renders the empty body as `null` (recorded here as a literal null, which replays identically). Nothing was delivered, so the RESULT line counts 0 and the run settles at zero credits (design D4).
